# libavoid-js 0.4.5

Unmodified index-node.mjs and libavoid.wasm from npm libavoid-js@0.4.5.
License: LGPL-2.1-or-later; see LICENSE in this directory.
Upstream source and build instructions: https://github.com/Aksem/libavoid-js/tree/v0.4.5
Underlying libavoid source: https://github.com/mjwybrow/adaptagrams

These files remain replaceable modules. DDS invokes them in the CLI to calculate
geometry; generated HTML includes coordinates only, not library code or WASM.
